BiblicalUsage: Keph means a hollow rock, a cliff. Job 30:6 says the outcasts dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks, and Jeremiah 4:29 says the people climb up upon the rocks when the horsemen come.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rocks are a poor hiding place from God, but a good picture of how the poor live when the world casts them out.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
